name: ClickUp
description_en:
ClickUp is a work-management platform whose actionable work lives in tasks inside Lists. Spaces and optional grouping levels organize the surrounding work, while views present the same underlying records differently. Tasks carry identifiers, status, assignees, dates, discussion and supporting context.

The important setup decision is what represents a project in your hierarchy. A small effort can be one task with subtasks, while a larger initiative may need several Lists grouped together. This profile examines that model, moving versus sharing tasks, permissions and automation capacity. The current retrieved pricing page contains conflicting package blocks, so advertised rates are not treated as a settled purchase quote.
description_zh:
ClickUp 是工作管理平台，可执行工作以任务形式保存在 List 中。Space 和可选的分组层级组织外围工作，不同视图呈现同一批底层记录。任务包含标识符、状态、负责人、日期、讨论和背景资料。

配置时首先要决定，层级中的什么对象代表项目。小型工作可以是一项带子任务的任务，大型举措则可能需要多份 List 并进行分组。本文核对这种模型、移动与共享任务的差别、权限和自动化容量。本次读取的定价页出现相互冲突的套餐区块，因此不把宣传费率当作已经确定的购买报价。

sections.title_en: Choose a project model before adding records
sections.title_zh: 添加记录前先选择项目模型
sections.en:
ClickUp’s guidance scales the hierarchy with the work. It suggests representing a small project as a task in a List, a medium project as a List, and a larger project as a Folder with separate Lists for stages. Those are vendor recommendations, not mandatory definitions.

For a hypothetical onboarding process, begin with one List containing tasks for account setup, training and completion review. Add grouping only when the reporting or ownership needs justify it. In a pilot, ask each participant to locate their work and explain which object owns its status. The aim is a consistent team model, not the maximum possible hierarchy depth.
sections.zh:
ClickUp 的指南建议按工作规模选择层级：小项目可是一份 List 中的任务，中型项目可用一份 List，大型项目可用包含各阶段 List 的 Folder。这些是厂商建议，不是强制定义。

假设要管理入职流程，可以先用一份 List 包含账户设置、培训和完成审阅任务。只有报表或责任划分确有需要时，再增加分组。试点时，让各参与者找到自己的工作，并说明状态由哪个对象管理。目标是团队模型一致，而非层级越深越好。

sections.title_en: The task remains the actionable record
sections.title_zh: 任务始终是可执行记录
sections.en:
A task has a unique ID and can hold status, priority, dates, assignees, subtasks and activity. ClickUp supports multiple assignees when that feature is used; the team still needs an agreement on who responds when work is late. The task must belong to at least one List.

For tasks appearing in several Lists, the introduction identifies the home List as the basis for status and Custom Fields. Do not assume adding the same task to a review List creates a separate review status. Verify the fields and ownership required by the actual handoff before designing a cross-team workflow.
sections.zh:
任务具有唯一 ID，可保存状态、优先级、日期、受派人员、子任务和活动。ClickUp 支持在启用相应能力时使用多位受派人员，但团队仍需约定逾期时由谁响应。每项任务至少属于一份 List。

对于同时出现在多份 List 的任务，概述文档指出，状态和 Custom Fields 以 home List 为基础。因此，把任务加入审阅 List，不应直接理解为创建了独立审阅状态。设计跨团队流程前，应核对实际交接所需的字段和责任。

sections.title_en: Adding and moving have different data consequences
sections.title_zh: 添加和移动带来不同数据后果
sections.en:
Adding a task to another List keeps it in the original List. Moving it removes the original membership. When destination statuses differ, ClickUp asks how to map the task and subtask statuses or set them all to one destination status. For Custom Fields absent from the destination, it offers choices about which fields to add.

Before moving a live project, try one representative task containing a custom status, a custom field and a subtask. Compare the destination state and the old List. This is a proposed migration check, not a claim that moving a task copies every aspect of its original environment unchanged.
sections.zh:
把任务添加到另一份 List，会保留其原 List 归属；移动则移除原归属。目标状态不同时，ClickUp 会要求映射任务及子任务状态，或统一设为某个目标状态。对于目标中不存在的 Custom Fields，也会提供选择，决定添加哪些字段。

移动真实项目前，应先选一条包含自定义状态、字段和子任务的代表性任务，比较目标结果与原 List。这是建议的迁移检查，不表示移动会原封不动复制任务原环境的所有方面。

sections.title_en: Specific rights and multi-List access both matter
sections.title_zh: 具体对象权限和多 List 访问均有影响
sections.en:
The permissions guide says task-specific permissions override List permissions, and more specific hierarchy levels take precedence in conflicts. It also states that for tasks in multiple Lists, full edit overrides edit, then comment, then view-only. User role affects what a given permission label permits.

A shared item should therefore be evaluated through its actual participant identities and locations. Check one viewer, one editor and any guest involved in the handoff. A restricted-looking parent or a familiar permission name is not enough to establish the effective rights on a task.
sections.zh:
权限指南说明，任务的特定权限会覆盖 List 权限，冲突时更具体的层级优先。同时，多 List 任务按 full edit、edit、comment、view-only 的顺序采用较高权限；用户角色也会影响同名权限允许的操作。

因此，应结合具体参与者身份和任务位置评估共享事项。建议检查一位查看者、一位编辑者，以及交接中的访客。父级看起来受限，或权限名称看起来熟悉，都不足以确定任务的最终有效权限。

sections.title_en: Monthly actions can stop an otherwise valid automation
sections.title_zh: 月度动作额度可能暂停有效自动化
sections.en:
An admin or owner must enable the Automation ClickApp. The help table separates active automations from monthly actions: for example, it lists five active automations and 100 monthly actions for Free Forever. It also gives per-automation structure limits and says Workspace automations pause when the action allowance is exceeded. Limits reset on the first of the month in the documented PST time basis.

A hypothetical task handoff that performs two actions per incoming task needs an action estimate based on both operations. Before relying on it, inspect usage, assign an owner and decide how to find tasks that need attention after a pause. This is planning advice; no automation was executed.
sections.zh:
管理员或所有者必须启用 Automation ClickApp。帮助表区分活跃自动化数和每月动作数，例如 Free Forever 列为五条活跃自动化、每月 100 个动作。文档还限制单条自动化结构，并说明动作额度超出后，会暂停工作区自动化。额度在文档所述 PST 时间口径的每月一日重置。

假设每条新任务交接执行两个动作，就需要同时计算这两个操作。正式依赖前，应检查用量、指定负责人，并决定暂停后如何找到需要补处理的任务。这是规划建议，本次未实际运行自动化。

sections.title_en: The retrieved pricing does not establish one payable plan
sections.title_zh: 读取结果不能确立唯一可支付套餐
sections.en:
The public page simultaneously exposes Unlimited/Business/Enterprise blocks and Core/Business/Enterprise/Max blocks. Business pricing and automation allowances differ between them; the help table also uses the earlier plan names. We leave normalized pricing and current paid action allowances unknown instead of selecting a block by assumption.

The FAQ explicitly says upgrades cover the entire Workspace and each Workspace upgrades separately. Price the actual member/guest mix and intended AI entitlement in checkout or a sales quote. Free Forever is listed as ongoing free use, but trials of paid features and AI credits have their own boundaries.
sections.zh:
公开页面同时出现 Unlimited／Business／Enterprise 和 Core／Business／Enterprise／Max 两组区块，其中 Business 价格及自动化额度不同，帮助表也沿用较早的套餐名称。因此，本文不靠猜测选择某组区块，标准化价格及当前付费动作额度保持未知。

FAQ 明确说明，升级覆盖整个工作区，不同工作区分别升级。应在结账或销售报价中按实际成员／访客组合和预期 AI 权益计算。Free Forever 列为持续免费使用，但付费功能试用和 AI 积分各有边界。

sections.title_en: Make the first pilot a complete handoff
sections.title_zh: 首次试点应覆盖完整交接
sections.en:
A useful pilot has a task with a real deliverable, a named owner, a date, a status change and a second participant who can verify the result. If the workflow needs a move to another List, include that transition and a permission check. Inspect the activity trail instead of relying only on a board position.

As an editorial judgment, ClickUp merits investigation when configurable work structure is valuable and someone will maintain it. If the requirement is only a minimal personal checklist, evaluate whether the extra hierarchy and settings are justified. This profile did not establish self-hosting rights, licensing terms, live integration recovery, offline behavior or regional purchasing conditions.
sections.zh:
有效试点应包含一项真实交付任务、明确负责人、日期、状态变化，以及能核对结果的第二位参与者。如果流程需要移动到另一份 List，应包含该转换和权限检查。应查看活动记录，而不只看卡片所在列。

从编辑判断看，当可配置工作结构有价值、且有人负责维护时，值得进一步评估 ClickUp。如果只需要最简个人清单，则应判断额外层级和设置是否值得。本文没有确立自托管权利、许可条款、实际集成恢复、离线行为或地区购买条件。
